identity.rule: A locked VAL: chosen percentage <= 0.1 and native winner count > 0

evidence_boundary: R107 adds an explicit short-path module to the fresh R84/R88B full18 selector. A_edge_factorized uses factorized evidence; B_connected_paths uses joint connected-path computation. This is not a MoE FFN or learned expert-routing experiment. Same complete fresh tensors and total parameter counts require actual factory/initialization proof; they do not imply equal active functional freedom or equal FLOPs. Actual counts and path specification come from the locked model, never estimates. Factorization is conditional on each round incoming node states, not global selector additivity. A retains trunk interactions; B also receives explicit composed fields, so this is not an isolated topology-only causal comparison. Original R88B physical TSP node0 role, methodID+34, geometry/distance, score MLP/maximin and original CE/comparison/risk/two-forward RDropObjective remain; 57,600 updates, logical batch1024. No donor, teacher, context labels, new targets, calibration, quota or auxiliary loss. R89A AdamW, R89B Muon and R84A are saved historical references, not rerun or newly parameter/FLOP-matched controls; R94B is optional, never a prerequisite. Fixed36 rescues, losses, false picks and aligned net costs/regret are separate from choice frequency. Native/FP64 ind and legal pools; TRAIN-fitted SBS; ALL task-equal. TEST is development-exposed; one whole-model full18 VAL checkpoint for full TRAIN/VAL/TEST/LIB; no TEST/LIB reselection. Actual standalone GPU-resident-input timing includes complete model graph/path construction and computation, excludes dataset I/O, CPU transfer and solvers, and is not end-to-end dataset latency. No routing-summary requirement. No online W&B equality/availability is asserted.

A_edge_factorized.rule: strict minimum whole18 VAL macro_vs_sbs_pct; first exact tie; common full-TRAIN SBS
A_edge_factorized.inference_rule: original score MLP utility differences and maximin; no calibration or solver quotas
A_edge_factorized.winner_rule: native int64 ind from locked source cache, verified against original FP64 argmin; never FP32 argmin
